verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Calendly serves an llms.txt at developer.calendly.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section. Every docs page is also available as clean Markdown by appending .md, and those pages point back to the llms.txt index, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: evidence of the full contents and coverage of the llms.txt index beyond the truncated probe snippet, and independent user reports of agents consuming it in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: For page Markdown, append .md to any URL.
